d:
Rajasthan’s panchayat polls raise a big question: can social media popularity translate into votes? Jodhpur influencer Omprakash Bishnoi, with over 21 lakh followers, got just 33 votes in his village election. A similar story emerged with Bigg Boss fame Ajaz Khan in Maharashtra. What do these results reveal about the gap between digital fame and ground-level political support?
